description: The active palette-anchored production style for compact 32x32 creatures based on read-only 8-bit Sprite Assembler references.
principles: Construct one readable creature from a controlled body plan before adding texture or effects.
Use one fixed elevated game camera and one ground plane in all four directions.
Build broad flat pixel masses with a small master-palette selection.
Use dark contact separations and focal marks instead of a continuous exterior outline.
Preserve anatomy, scale, grounding, and material ramps through every direction and frame.

color.pureBlackPolicy: forbidden; use the shared shadow-line color

ramps.purpose: moss, leaves, forest hide, muted green material
reptile skin, wet vegetation, bog creatures
wood, bark, soil, leather, brown hide
bone, tusk, dry fungus, pale natural material
red fungus, wounds, fire-adjacent accents, warning color
moonlit fey, cool wings, spectral or night material
tongue, inner ear, exposed flesh, restrained organic accent

shape.singlePixelNoise: forbidden unless it is a required focal mark
shape.minimumFeatureRule: A feature must form a readable cluster at 1x and remain attached to its parent body mass.

shading.mode: broad flat clusters with at most one shadow and one highlight per material mass

motion.grounding: support anatomy remains attached and returns to a stable shared ground plane
motion.idle: one restrained living change without silhouette jitter
motion.locomotion: clear contact, passing, lift, and settle phases
motion.attack: body-first anticipation, action, impact, and recovery readable without effects
motion.hurt: brief directional recoil without identity loss
motion.cast: clear body origin, buildup, release, and recovery
motion.death: loss of support followed by a readable final resting pose

prohibitions: continuous exterior outline around the whole creature
checkerboard, lattice, or evenly scattered texture
full side-view silhouette rotated vertically for down or up
limbs, feet, wings, fins, or tails detached from their parent mass
copying reference pixels as a substitute for drawing the requested subject

references.purpose: quadruped simplification, flat masses, direction clarity
long low quadruped foreshortening and ground-plane rotation
flying body-plan readability and moss ramp
fungus body plan, simple face anchor, warm accent ramp
compact biped construction and bone ramp
four-direction flyer rotation and moon-cool ramp
